scope: real native folder-watch fixture; production manager unchanged

supersedes.reason: Root integration disproved stability of the readiness-then-target fixture, including a quiescent control. Prior local green receipts are historical evidence, not a current closure claim.

source_mutation.negative: actual native watcher kept; removing only production onChange delivery fails the same 8000ms deadline with zero published target and zero observed callbacks

findings.root_quiescent_failure: Actual readiness callback arrived at 4834ms; target was only then published and was not observed by the original shared 8000ms deadline. This test-invented handshake demands two separately delayed native batches.
findings.directory_comparison: Exact root Agent cwd, pinned loader, Node v20.20.2, and actual production manager registered real fs.watch successfully in both default canonical os.tmpdir and /private/tmp. Both initial batches arrived at 4224ms. No observed registration error or early close. This does not support claiming the default T directory is unsupported.
findings.single_publication_control: With one atomic target publication, both default T and /private/tmp delivered the actual native target filename at 1758ms; exit 0 and exact production callback/file checks passed in both.
findings.limits: The exact macOS/kernel scheduling cause of all prior missing/delayed events is not established. A single green suite does not guarantee all future native latency. The fixture retains the 8s bound and now reports native registration, errors, closure, raw filenames/timestamps, actual production callbacks and safe environment metadata on failure.

fix.loader: Declared pinned tsx via file URL in a bounded child importing the actual production module; explicit Agent cwd.
fix.watcher: Observational wrapper calls actual fs.watch with the original production arguments, records raw callback, then forwards the exact callback to production. No synthetic event or replacement manager.
fix.publication: One atomic rename after watcher registration, followed by quiescence. The real target callback is itself the readiness evidence; no extra ready-file round.

real_registration_failure.fault: Remove the owned watched directory immediately before production bind; actual OS fs.watch throws ENOENT, swallowed by production catch.
real_registration_failure.result: Fixture immediately rejects and records registered=false plus native ENOENT; no fake watcher.

source_mutation.conclusion: Negative rejects at 8s, but native raw delivery is also absent, so this run is inconclusive for isolating callback-mutation sensitivity and is not claimed as proof.
